prompts.text: Should I buy Microsoft before its next earnings report?
prompts.note: Named security plus an explicit buy decision.

prompts.text: My Tesla thesis has weakened. Should I reduce the position or keep holding?
prompts.note: Named security plus a live reduce-or-hold decision.

prompts.text: Is Amazon a sensible three-year investment from here?
prompts.note: Named security, horizon, and investment judgment request.

prompts.text: I do not have a portfolio file here. Would you still recommend adding Nvidia now?
prompts.note: No-book wording must not block a named-security decision.

prompts.text: For new money, would you choose Apple or wait for a better entry?
prompts.note: Named security and explicit allocation choice.

prompts.text: AMD is down sharply since I bought it; should I exit, add, or do nothing?
prompts.note: Named security with three live actions.

prompts.text: Find a shortlist of profitable cybersecurity stocks worth researching for a five-year hold.
Screen for renewable-energy companies with improving free cash flow and tell me which look investable.
prompts.note: Explicit discovery with filters and selection request.

prompts.text: Which semiconductor-equipment stocks should I compare for a long-term position?
prompts.note: Requests a candidate set for an investment decision.

prompts.text: Give me three public-company alternatives to Costco and rank them as investments.
prompts.note: Alternative discovery and ranking are explicit.

prompts.text: Help me discover income ETFs for a retirement-account watchlist, with coverage limits.
prompts.note: Explicit candidate discovery despite no named starting ticker.

prompts.text: Build a small shortlist of US software companies with durable margins that may be worth buying.
What does a price-to-earnings ratio measure?
prompts.note: Pure investing education with no decision.

prompts.text: What was Nvidia's official closing price yesterday?
prompts.note: Named security but only a market-data lookup.

prompts.text: List the companies currently in the Dow Jones Industrial Average.
prompts.note: Universe lookup without candidate selection or investment intent.

prompts.text: Which firms are classified in the S&P 500 energy sector? I only need the constituent list.
prompts.note: List retrieval explicitly disclaims candidate evaluation.

prompts.text: Explain the difference between a market order and a limit order.
When does the Nasdaq regular trading session open in New York time?
